comparison.objective: Hang two parts on separate continuously moving conveyor hooks before a deadline.
comparison.physical_skill: Time grasp, eye-to-hook insertion, and release against moving targets without impeding them.
comparison.success_condition: Each part hangs freely on its own hook for the final second before the hook crosses the mark; hooks remain on schedule.
comparison.reason: This tests time-critical insertion onto moving hooks. The candidate's moving response occurs only after adjustment, in a separate guarded impact fixture.
